review_basis: Frozen report prose, extracted elements, final plans and generated P/I/V. Model output and Z3 were not treated as ground truth.

ratings.reason: The report contains two explicit failure branches and sufficient P/I/V. The final plan selected only the first-purchase branch but omitted the separate pair-not-created numeric P source; the numeric completeness guard rejected all attempts.
The numeric completeness guard interpreted protocol identifiers ERC-4337 and EIP-191 as unselected numeric P literals. This is a confirmed mechanical false rejection, not missing report semantics.

The formula applies only while creator_internal_balance >= campaign_amount, but the reported attack first withdraws that balance and reaches the insufficient-balance fallback. The resulting I is vacuous in the attack state and V does not directly encode Bob paying under insufficient creator balance.

The authorization and theft relation is faithful. P maps the separate delegatecall fact to the same router_publicly_callable Boolean, so that implementation precondition is not independently represented.

The formula faithfully forbids unregistration while invested assets and outstanding shares exist. access_control is a loose taxonomy label for what is more naturally a state-validity obligation, but the fixed relation itself is correct.

summary.interpretation: Small assistant artifact review, not expert gold or population accuracy.
